description: Bootstrap 5, compiled from its Sass sources
agents: Styles: Bootstrap 5. Entry `src/app/styles/styles.scss`, compiled by YASSB's Sass from `node_modules/bootstrap/scss`; change Bootstrap's variables in the `with (...)` of the `@use`. Use Bootstrap's classes in the HTML. Components that need JavaScript (collapse, dropdown, modal) need `import 'bootstrap';` in the browser script entry.
